materialization: The exact primary ownership relation is materialized by R28_COMPRESSION_V0.1.json items[*].SOURCE_UNITS. Each listed parse unit has the item's ITEM_ID as its sole primary compression owner. Single-unit items use DIRECT_TO_COMPRESSION_ITEM; multi-unit items use LOSS_BOUNDED_GROUP_TO_COMPRESSION_ITEM.
warrant_rule: SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_COUNT does not establish warrant independence. Multi-unit items retain WARRANT_INDEPENDENCE_STATUS=NOT_ESTABLISHED and WARRANT_MULTIPLICITY_EFFECT=NONE.
secondary_reuse: No secondary alias changes primary ownership or warrant multiplicity.
